subject: Suggested restart after rate-limit failure
body: DevinCLILLM retries four times with sleeps 5+10+20s, but Doudna hit a reported 37s cooldown. A resumed check with lower --workers may avoid another burst; current checked.jsonl lets it skip 20 done docs. Owain pairs still has six concurrent child calls and only five partial rows after 38 minutes, so consider its rate limit before starting more work.
